summary: The kit's minimal REAL agent evals, published beside it and taken only by a host that wants them: one per dispatch adapter, each a one-sentence temptation on a fixture host, on the cheapest sufficient model, capped, judged by the gates and `check` -- never by the worker. Run with `trial`; re-run only when what they measure changes. The everyday proof is the scripted worker in the kit's own suite, at zero tokens (ADR-024).
